summary: Detailed changelog and technical documentation of the system enhancements: Read-only System Activity audit logs view, Full Add/Edit/Delete in Catalog Master for Categories and Units, Dual-Worksheet Excel order export (Order Details & Items Breakdown), Master Admin 6-word password protection with in-panel modification, Geographic Territories manager & free-text location routing, Optional/removable sales tax with customizable percentage, Customer 360 view with new vs older orders history, Glassmorphism & subtle glow styling, and dark/light mode fix.
